description: This file contains C source code implementing process and system resource monitoring functions, including process usage, CPU, and memory info retrieval, as well as system command execution for top and ps commands. It includes functions for parsing /proc data, executing system commands, and managing process info structures.

methods.name: getProcUsage
methods.description: Retrieves CPU and memory usage for a specified process name, populating a vector with results.

methods.name: getProcPidStat
methods.description: Reads process statistics from /proc/[pid]/stat to fill process info structure.

methods.name: getProcInfo
methods.description: Aggregates process memory and CPU info for a set of process IDs.

methods.name: getMemInfo
methods.description: Calculates total memory usage of processes based on their RSS from /proc/[pid]/stat.

methods.name: saveTopOutput
methods.description: Executes 'top' command to save system process info into a temporary file.

methods.name: removeTopOutput
methods.description: Removes the temporary file containing 'top' output.

methods.name: getCPUInfo
methods.description: Retrieves CPU usage information for processes or total device CPU time.

methods.name: getProcessCpuUtilization
methods.description: Calculates CPU utilization percentage for a specific process ID.
